requirements.text: Immutable global generations preserve exact articles, source versions and hashes, topology, rubric, Playbook, templates and derivative profile with complete checksums. Only a complete validated generation may become current. Concurrent activation has one winner, readers see a coherent release, and failed builds leave the prior release serving. Rollback is a new attributable reviewed activation of a revalidated prior generation, preserving current entitlement and source provenance without organization adoption or departed-body access. Activation storage and concurrency mechanisms follow Everyfield patterns.

behavior_rules.rule: Build isolated candidate complete global corpus outside DB locks; checkpoint current claim, bound provider budget. Never import unknown old vectors/leave removed trailing chunks or activate partial generation.
